purpose: Per CEO R280 P3: 'The machine should produce the complete collaborator package: protocol + materials list + sample requirements + analysis code + acceptance criteria + budget + data submission format.' Next action is external collaborator acquisition, not more simulation.
constitutional_basis: Article XXXIV — reality is the next bottleneck. Article XXVI — external collaborator provides independent validation.
what_the_collaborator_receives: 2. Materials and equipment list (with vendors, catalog numbers, costs)
3. Sample requirements (what the collaborator must prepare/provide)
4. Analysis code (Python scripts for data analysis — ELISA curve fitting, kinetics, statistics)
6. Budget breakdown (line-item, with personnel + reagents + equipment)
7. Data submission format (JSON schema for structured reporting back)

1_protocol.summary: 7-step protocol: enzyme → concentration → CSF matrix → stability → catalytic → toxicity → acceptance. 3 candidate enzymes (NEP, IDE, MMP-9). 30-day stability test. Michaelis-Menten kinetics. ISO 10993-5 cytotoxicity, ISO 10993-4 hemocompatibility, CSF cell compatibility.

csf_matrix_components.name: Glucose, lactate, NaCl, KCl, CaCl2, MgCl2 (analytical grade)

hemocompatibility.name: Human whole blood (fresh, consented donor)
hemocompatibility.vendor: Local blood bank or IRB-approved collection

what_collaborator_must_prepare: Lab space with BSL-2 capability for cell culture
Personnel: 1 biochemist (FTE, 3 months) + 1 cell biologist (0.5 FTE, 1 month)
Access to ELISA plate reader, incubator, biosafety cabinet
IRB approval if using human blood (for hemocompatibility test)
Animal model NOT required for Phase 1 (Phase 1 is entirely in vitro)
what_we_provide: All enzyme and substrate specifications (vendor, catalog, quantity)
Analysis code (Python, no dependencies — see section 4)
Data submission format (JSON schema — see section 7)
Acceptance criteria (pre-registered, cannot be silently relaxed — see section 5)

scripts.name: 01_elisa_curve_fit.py
scripts.function: Fit 4-parameter logistic curve to ELISA standard curve, compute Aβ42 concentrations from OD readings
scripts.input: CSV with standard concentrations and OD readings
scripts.output: JSON with fitted parameters and sample concentrations

scripts.name: 02_stability_analysis.py
scripts.function: Compute activity retention curve over 30 days. Fit exponential decay model. Compute half-life.
scripts.output: JSON with decay rate, half-life, day-30 retention, go/no-go verdict

scripts.name: 03_kinetics_fit.py
scripts.function: Fit Michaelis-Menten model to initial rate vs substrate concentration data. Compute Km, Vmax, kcat.
scripts.output: JSON with Km, Vmax, kcat, R² of fit, go/no-go verdict

scripts.name: 04_toxicity_analysis.py
scripts.function: Compute cell viability, hemolysis rate, complement activation. Compare to acceptance thresholds.
scripts.output: JSON with per-test verdict and overall go/no-go

scripts.name: 05_generate_report.py
scripts.function: Aggregate all results into a single report with provenance, acceptance criteria evaluation, and recommendation
scripts.output: Final report JSON + human-readable markdown summary

4_analysis_code.status: TO BE WRITTEN (next step after collaborator engagement — the code is straightforward, ~500 lines total)

go_criteria: kcat >= 1 s^-1 for the winning enzyme (catalytic)
CSF cell compatibility: >= 80% viability, IL-6 < 2x baseline, TNF-α < 2x baseline
5_acceptance_criteria.rule: ALL criteria must pass for GO. Partial pass is NO-GO. Cannot be silently relaxed (Article XXVII).

6_budget_breakdown.personnel_3_months: $25K-60K (1 biochemist FTE + 0.5 cell biologist FTE, depending on seniority and location)
6_budget_breakdown.equipment_amortization: $2K-5K (if incubator/cabinet/reader need to be purchased; $0 if lab already has them)
6_budget_breakdown.facility_overhead: $5K-10K (university or CRO overhead, typically 20-30% of direct costs)
6_budget_breakdown.payment_schedule: 50% on start, 25% at day-15 interim report, 25% on final report submission

schema.raw_data_path: string (path or URL to raw ELISA OD values, cell counts, etc.)

7_data_submission_format.rule: Results must be submitted in this format. Raw data must be included or linked. Provenance is mandatory (Article XII).

collaborator_engagement_process.step_1_identify: Identify 3-5 candidate labs with enzyme engineering + biocompatibility testing capability. Examples: MIT BME, Stanford BME, Rice BME, Northwestern BME, or a CRO like WuXi AppTec.
collaborator_engagement_process.step_2_send_package: Send this complete package to each candidate. No NDA needed to review the protocol.
collaborator_engagement_process.step_3_evaluate_responses: Select collaborator based on: (a) capability, (b) timeline, (c) cost, (d) willingness to follow frozen protocol.
collaborator_engagement_process.step_4_execute: Collaborator executes Phase 1. We do NOT consult during execution (Article XXVI — independent validation).
collaborator_engagement_process.step_5_results: Collaborator submits results in the specified JSON format. We publish results alongside our pre-registered predictions.
collaborator_engagement_process.step_6_decision: If GO → proceed to Phase 2 (immobilization). If NO-GO → P-04 enters cemetery with documented failure mode.
